note: step 1/10 - a SAP A/R invoice is picked on the Dispatch Plans screen and a vehicle+transporter+driver+planned dispatch date are attached to it. Creates the dispatch_plan row.
step 2/10 - the empty truck is gate-in-ed. One EVGI-* entry PER COMPANY it will load for. Creates the arrival (ARV-*) if the truck is new at the plate.
step 3/10 - the gate-in entry is linked to the booked bill(s); the truck is queued for a dock.
step 4/10 - the docking record (DOCK-*) opens. From here the bill is locked to this truck; the app tells you why a bill can no longer be removed ("loading has started (boxes scanned)").
step 5/10 - a photo of the loaded truck is uploaded, with GPS lat/long stamped on it.
step 6/10 - scan counts reconcile against the invoice; any short/skip goes to the docking-admin exception queue for a supervisor.
step 7/10 - gatepass DCK/<COMPANY>/2026-27/###### is printed with a random_code on it.
step 8/10 - the print is committed - the gatepass can no longer be silently reprinted without a reprint record.
step 9/10 - security marks the truck out. dispatched_at + gate_out_date/out_time are stamped. THIS is the moment the godown space is actually free.
step 10/10 - off-ramp: the docking is rejected/cancelled with a reason and the bill goes back to the pool.
